Each nation has 5 Leaders to choose from.DETAIL: Each nation has 5 historical leaders to choose from. Only one Leader is active at a time. The active Leader provides passive army-wide buffs AND one active ability usable once per raid. Leaders are unlocked through trophy milestones and RP investment.

Each nation has 7 historical Generals available. Players select up to 3 Generals for their roster. Up to 2 Generals can be brought into any single raid. Generals are placed directly in the formation grid like regular units and fight alongside the army.

Each General has HP, DPS, Speed, Range, Armor, a special ability and an aura. Standard aura: +10% DPS and +10% HP to the General's two classes within 2 tiles (tunable). Generals are among the toughest units in the game but are not invincible.

If a General is destroyed during a raid they are Wounded. A Wounded General cannot be deployed in the next raid but recovers automatically. There is no permanent death. Players must manage General risk carefully - bringing both Generals into a difficult raid risks losing both.

The Leader active ability is triggered manually by the player once per raid during the Planning Phase or first 30 seconds of the raid. It cannot be saved for later - if not used in the first 30 seconds it triggers automatically. Each Leader ability is unique and tied to their historical doctrine.

Leader 1 of each nation is unlocked free with the nation. Leaders 2-4 require trophy milestones (500, 1500, 3000 trophies). Leader 5 requires nation Prestige. Generals 1-3 unlock with Tier II III IV respectively. Generals 4-6 require specific trophy counts. General 7 requires nation Prestige.

All Leaders and Generals are real historical commanders. Stats and abilities are inspired by their documented historical doctrine and battlefield reputation. Germany gets Rommel and Guderian. USSR gets Zhukov and Konev. USA gets Patton and Eisenhower. Britain gets Montgomery and Churchill. Japan gets Yamamoto and Yamashita.

Generals are placed in the formation grid before launch. They occupy one grid slot like a regular unit. Their aura buff applies to all units within their aura radius in the grid - front and rear. A General in Row 2 center buffs the most units. Generals in Row 1 lead the charge but take more damage.

Bringing 2 Generals doubles the buff coverage but doubles the risk. If both are destroyed in the same raid both sit out the next raid. Players must weigh the tactical benefit of 2 Generals against the risk of both being wounded simultaneously.
A general-only class for air-landed commanders (Student, Gavin). Special units are delivered by air into the base interior. There is no infantry in the game.
Historical figures only. Fictional commanders are not used.
